reason: I already run my clients' campaigns on another provider with their sender IDs approved and lists loaded, and a few cents less per SMS is not worth re-registering every client's name and moving their lists in the middle of the 12.12 rush. I might do the 10 free test SMS out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay this month.
objection: Switching means getting every client's sender name approved again and trusting a new gateway's delivery right before the busiest sale of the year, and I still doubt the people on these lists actually read SMS offers instead of ignoring them as spam.
would_change_my_mind: An agency account where I can manage several clients' sender names and credits under one login, with a proven delivery report showing better delivery than my current provider, so the switch is clearly worth it.
